definitions.explanation: A warm, friendly feeling toward someone or something. The sense of closeness or approachability that makes someone feel comfortable.

examples.japanese: {親|した}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: To feel a sense of familiarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親|した}しみやすい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: That teacher is an approachable person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{親|した}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こみ{上|あ}げてくる。
examples.english: When I hear the local dialect, nostalgia and a warm sense of familiarity well up inside me.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{親|した}しむ→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧ (to feel close to, to be familiar with). Describes a warm, approachable quality in people, places, or things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親|した}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel familiarity/affection
- {親|した}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with affection, affectionately
- {親|した}しみやすい: approachable, easy to feel close to
- {親|した}しみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: a friendly smile
- {親|した}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: to feel warmth toward someone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧: attachment (deeper emotional bond, often to objects or places)
- ⟦{好意|こうい}→好意：12207_koui⟧: goodwill, favorable feeling (more formal; can imply romantic interest)
- ⟦{親近感|しんきんかん}→親近感：19224_shinkinkan⟧: feeling of closeness (similar but slightly more formal; often used toward public figures)
